name: SPS3
fullName: Secondary Prevention of Small Subcortical Strokes — clopidogrel added to aspirin after lacunar stroke
population: n=3020, mean 63; 63% men, NIHSS recent symptomatic lacunar infarct, long-term secondary prevention; mean follow-up 3.4 years
teachingPoint: Do not use long-term aspirin + clopidogrel after lacunar stroke — no benefit, doubled major bleeding, increased mortality.
